为塞来西布联用培朵普利组和安慰剂联用培朵普利组观察治疗前后小时动态血压参数的变化并比较组间的差异用以评价塞来西布对培朵普利降压作用的影响结果治疗前后小时动态血压的参数变化在两组病人间无明显统计学意义结论塞来西布对培朵普利的降压作用没有影响。Effects of celecoxib on blood pressure with ACE inhibitors
LIU Jing．（The Second People’s Hosp．of ShenzhenGuangdong518026China）［Abstact ］ Objective To observe the effects on24－h ambulatory blood pressure in hypertensive patients with arthritis on ACE inhibitors．Methods Patients with hypertension and arthritis were included in the study．In the first stage of the studyall subjects received perindopril 4mg qd for1month or longer until stable blood pressures were reached．In the second stage of the studyall the subjects were divided randomly into celecoxib group or placebo group．During the whole studythe doses of perindopril and celecoxib remained unchanged．Before and after the therapya24－h ambulatory blood pressure was obtained from every subjects and it’s parameters were compared between the two groups．Results There was no significant statistical difference between the two group on the blood pressure parameters．Conclusion In our studycelecoxib show no statistically significant attenuation on ambulatory blood pressure in hyptensive patients with ACEI．高血压和骨关节疾病包括非特异性的骨关节炎症和痛风、类风湿性关节炎等）都是临床常见的疾病而且常常并发于同一患者身上尤其多见于老年患者因此在医师的处方上常需同时应用降压药如血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂类药物和解热镇痛药目前已有一些资料表明非甾体类消炎药如阿司匹林芬必得吲哚美辛等由于通过非选择性抑制还氧化酶（COX）活性、抑制前列腺素合成和血浆肾素活性因此可以拮抗甚至消除类药物的抗高血压疗效尤其在老年人和低肾素活性的高血压患者［1］ 。
